title: Scaffold uuencoding crate (Cargo.toml, lib.rs, error.rs)
description:
Create the crate skeleton.

- New directory: uuencoding/ in the MIME workspace root (add to workspace Cargo.toml members)
- Cargo.toml: name='uuencoding', version='0.1.0', edition='2021', license='MIT OR Apache-2.0', rust-version='1.75'
- No dependencies beyond serde (optional, feature-gated) for Serialize/Deserialize on public types
- src/lib.rs: crate-level doc explaining what UUencoding is, its pre-MIME history, the two use cases (CTE-declared and inline), and the security note (decoded output can be larger than encoded input; caller must apply size limits before passing to decompressors)
- src/error.rs: UuError enum with variants:
    InvalidBeginLine { line: String }  -- begin line malformed or missing
    BeginBase64  -- begin-base64 detected; use a base64 decoder instead
    UnexpectedEof  -- end line never found; data field on DecodedBlock will be partial
    InvalidChar { line: usize, col: usize, byte: u8 }  -- byte outside valid UU range
  All variants: Debug, Display, std::error::Error. Non-exhaustive.
- Public re-exports in lib.rs: UuError, BlockMetadata, DecodedBlock, BlockLocation, decode, encode, scan
- Quality gate must pass: cargo fmt, cargo clippy -p uuencoding -- -D warnings, cargo test -p uuencoding
